detailed_description: The JSON to Swift tool generates simple Swift struct definitions from pasted JSON in the browser. You can edit the root struct name, toggle whether generated structs conform to Codable, click Convert, and copy the output. The converter parses JSON with JSON.parse, uses the first item of an array when the input is an array of objects, creates nested structs for nested objects, converts underscore-separated keys to camelCase property names, and infers basic Swift types such as String, Int, Double, Bool, arrays, nested structs, Any, and Any?. It does not provide syntax highlighting, configurable visibility, documentation comments, CodingKeys, enum generation, schema analysis, file import, or Xcode project integration.
usage_steps: Paste JSON into the input textarea or edit the sample object.
Choose whether generated structs should include Codable conformance.
Click Convert to generate Swift struct code.
Review the output textarea and copy the generated code when needed.
usage_examples: Generate a starter Swift struct from a small API response sample.
Create nested structs from a pasted object that contains a child object.
Compare output with and without Codable conformance before copying the code.
Use the first object in a sample array to scaffold a basic Swift struct.
